categories.label: Latency Arbitrage
categories.description: Dealing on stale quotes: tick-tape-proved entry markouts, fast holds, extraction. ML target = tape-proved labels.

categories.label: News/Event/Vol
categories.description: Profitable activity on the fixed event calendar (macro prints + market-derived synchronized-volatility minutes). ML target = the rule holding over the next 5 days with client equity rising.

categories.label: Toxic Flow
categories.description: Positive short-horizon markout: fills that are adverse selection against the book.

categories.label: High Magnitude
categories.description: Position sizes far above peer scale.

categories.label: Bonus Arbitrage
categories.definition: bonus_extraction >= 0.9 and life_pnl > 0 and life_days_active <= 20 and life_profit_factor >= 1.5

categories.label: High Exposure / Recovery
categories.description: Oversized positions held to recover drawdowns.
